data.name: Thunder Call
data.description: The thundercaller can start a performance to unleash a deafening peal of thunder. This allows the thundercaller to spend a round of performance to create an effect similar to the spell sound burst (%1d8 damage and stunned for 1 round, close range, 10-ft. area spread, DC %2 Fortitude for half damage, not stunned). A creature that succeeds at its saving throw against thunder call is immune to the stunning effect but still takes sonic damage. Beginning this performance is always a standard action.|ThundercallerThunderDamageDice|12+CHA
